theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L F → MeasurableSet B → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖F a - F a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ F a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ F a)) → ∀ᵐ b ∂(volume.restrict B), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (F '' B) (F b) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F b : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
